t: $(thing)Vegetable Oil/$ can be produced in a $(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$ from various $(thing)seeds/$ and $(thing)crops/$. Seeds tend to be a better source of oil than grown crops. Vegetable Oil is required in the production of $(l:renewables/biodiesel)Biodiesel/$.
$(thing)植物油/$可以在$(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)热气动加工机/$中由各种$(thing)种子/$和$(thing)作物/$生产。种子通常比成熟作物更适合作为油料来源。植物油是生产$(l:renewables/biodiesel)生物柴油/$所必需的。
